C     ECPT( 5) = SIL GRID POINT 3
C     ECPT( 6) = SIL GRID POINT 4
C     ECPT( 7) = COORD SYS ID GRID PT 1

C     ECPT(10) = Z1
C     ECPT(11) = COORD SYS ID GRID PT 2

C     ECPT(15) = COORD SYS ID GRID PT 3

C     ECPT(17) = Y3
C     ECPT(18) = Z3
C     ECPT(19) = COORD SYS ID GRID PT 4

C     ECPT(21) = Y4
C     ECPT(22) = Z4

C     JTYPE = 1 FOR WEDGE, = 2 FOR HEXA1, = 3 FOR HEXA2, AND = 0 TETRA
C     IF JTYPE IS NEGATIVE, THIS IS LAST CALL FROM KSOLID

      LOGICAL         NOGO    ,HEAT      ,HYDRO
      INTEGER         OUT     ,NECPT(4)  ,DIREC    ,EL(2,4)  ,SCR4
      REAL            NU      ,MATBUF
      DOUBLE PRECISION C      ,G         ,H        ,TEMP     ,HDETER  ,
     1                TEMP1   ,T         ,CT       ,KIJ      ,GCT
      CHARACTER       UFM*23
      COMMON /XMSSG / UFM

#include <Eigen/Dense>
#include <iostream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <cmath>

using namespace Eigen;

int main() {
    // Node coordinates
    // N1=(0,0,0), N2=(1,0,0), N3=(0,1,0), N4=(0,0,1)
    double x[4] = {0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0};
    double y[4] = {0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0};
    double z[4] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0};

    double E = 200e9;
    double nu = 0.3;
    double GG = E / (2.0 * (1.0 + nu));

    // Build H (4x4): rows [1, x, y, z]
    Matrix4d H;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        H(i, 0) = 1.0;
        H(i, 1) = x[i];
        H(i, 2) = y[i];
        H(i, 3) = z[i];
    }

    // Invert H
    Matrix4d Hinv = H.inverse();
    double HDETER = H.determinant();

    // G material matrix (6x6)
    Matrix<double, 6, 6> G = Matrix<double, 6, 6>::Zero();
    double TEMP1 = (1.0 + nu) * (1.0 - 2.0 * nu);
    double g1 = E * (1.0 - nu) / TEMP1;
    double g2 = E * nu / TEMP1;
    // Fortran G is column-major 6x6, indices 1..36
    // G(1)=g1, G(8)=g1, G(15)=g1  -> diagonal (1,1),(2,2),(3,3)
    // G(2)=g2, G(3)=g2, G(7)=g2, G(9)=g2, G(13)=g2, G(14)=g2
    // G(22)=GG, G(29)=GG, G(36)=GG -> (4,4),(5,5),(6,6)
    G(0,0) = g1; G(1,1) = g1; G(2,2) = g1;
    G(0,1) = g2; G(0,2) = g2;
    G(1,0) = g2; G(1,2) = g2;
    G(2,0) = g2; G(2,1) = g2;
    G(3,3) = GG; G(4,4) = GG; G(5,5) = GG;

    // Build C matrices (6x3) for each node i=1..4
    // Fortran: J = 18*I - 18 (0-based offset into C array of 72)
    // C(J+1)=H(I+4), C(J+5)=H(I+8), C(J+9)=H(I+12)
    // C(J+11)=H(I+12), C(J+12)=H(I+8), C(J+13)=H(I+12)
    // C(J+15)=H(I+4), C(J+16)=H(I+8), C(J+17)=H(I+4)
    // H is column-major 4x4: H(k) with k=1..16, H(row,col) = H((col-1)*4+row)
    // H(I+4) = H(row=I, col=2) = Hinv(I-1, 1)
    // H(I+8) = H(row=I, col=3) = Hinv(I-1, 2)
    // H(I+12)= H(row=I, col=4) = Hinv(I-1, 3)
    // C is column-major 6x3: C(J+k) = C(row=k, col=?) 
    // C(J+1) -> row1 col1; C(J+5) -> row5 col1; C(J+9) -> row3 col2
    // Let me map: C(J+1)=row1col1, C(J+5)=row5col1, C(J+9)=row3col2
    // C(J+11)=row5col2, C(J+12)=row6col2, C(J+13)=row1col3
    // C(J+15)=row3col3, C(J+16)=row4col3, C(J+17)=row5col3

    // C matrix (6x3) per node
    Matrix<double, 6, 3> C[4];
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        C[i].setZero();
        double h2 = Hinv(i, 1); // H(I+4)
        double h3 = Hinv(i, 2); // H(I+8)
        double h4 = Hinv(i, 3); // H(I+12)
        // C(J+1)=h2 -> (0,0)
        C[i](0, 0) = h2;
        // C(J+5)=h3 -> (4,0)
        C[i](4, 0) = h3;
        // C(J+9)=h4 -> (2,1)
        C[i](2, 1) = h4;
        // C(J+11)=h4 -> (4,1)
        C[i](4, 1) = h4;
        // C(J+12)=h3 -> (5,1)
        C[i](5, 1) = h3;
        // C(J+13)=h4 -> (0,2)
        C[i](0, 2) = h4;
        // C(J+15)=h2 -> (2,2)
        C[i](2, 2) = h2;
        // C(J+16)=h3 -> (3,2)
        C[i](3, 2) = h3;
        // C(J+17)=h2 -> (4,2)
        C[i](4, 2) = h2;
    }

    // HDETER = |det| / 6
    HDETER = std::fabs(HDETER) / 6.0;

    // GCT = C_pivot^T * G * HDETER (3x6)
    // Pivot is node 1 (NPVT). In the test, pivot = node 1.
    // GCT = C[0]^T * G * HDETER
    Matrix<double, 3, 6> GCT = C[0].transpose() * G * HDETER;

    // KIJ for each node i: T = GCT * C[i]  (3x3)
    // K_ij = C_i^T * G * C_j * HDETER
    // Assemble 12x12 stiffness matrix
    MatrixXd K = MatrixXd::Zero(12, 12);

    // For each pair (i,j), K_ij = C_i^T * G * C_j * HDETER
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            Matrix3d Kij = C[i].transpose() * G * C[j] * HDETER;
            K.block<3,3>(3*i, 3*j) = Kij;
        }
    }

    // Output JSON
    std::cout << "{\"stiffness_matrix\":[";
    for (int r = 0; r < 12; r++) {
        std::cout << "[";
        for (int c = 0; c < 12; c++) {
            std::cout << std::scientific << std::setprecision(6) << K(r, c);
            if (c < 11) std::cout << ",";
        }
        std::cout << "]";
        if (r < 11) std::cout << ",";
    }
    std::cout << "]}" << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
